title: Perfect Number
description: Determine if a positive integer is a perfect number, which is a number equal to the sum of its positive divisors excluding itself.
pseudocode:
1. if num <= 1 return false
2. sum = 1
3. for i = 2; i * i <= num; i++
4. if num % i == 0
5. sum += i
6. if i * i != num sum += num / i
7. return sum == num

steps.note: Check if 6 is less than or equal to 1. It is not.
Initialize sum to 1 (since 1 is always a divisor).
Start loop from i=2. i*i (4) <= 6 is true.
Check if i*i != num (4 != 6). True. Add quotient 6/2 = 3 to sum. sum = 3 + 3 = 6.
Increment i to 3. i*i (9) <= 6 is false. Terminate loop.
Check if sum (6) == num (6). Returns true.
